lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to find and fix more than one bug in a script by testing after each fix.
Sometimes there is more than one bug.
Find one, fix it, then test again.
Watch where it goes wrong FIRST.
Every bug you fix makes you a better coder.
Two bugs! The duck should go right 2, then down 2 to the pond (star).
The number was wrong AND the arrow was wrong. Two bugs squashed!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
